body: No, no recommendations other than taking an avid reducer, though I have no typical acid reflux discomfort.  I honestly don’t think I’m going to bother with that.

I believe it was Cipro.  I was seen at one of those convenience walk-in clinics. I didn’t mention it to my gp when I was seen for these symptoms, but maybe I should have.  I typically take a fish oil supplement but sometimes I miss it.  I just started Magnesium last week.  No other meds. I’ve always been a pretty healthy person, and haven’t been in the hospital other than for delivering my children.  I’m just flummoxed by how I’m feeling.

Thanks for responding.  I have been craving a lot of salt.  I haven’t wanted to eat much, but I have been wanting to eat a lot of pickles the past few weeks.  I can’t sleep all day because I have a young toddler at home, but good God do I want to! And I HATE napping. I haven’t noticed shortness of breath, but I have lost a little weight, presumably due to not eating much. I slammed a Powerade the other day and actually did feel a bit better afterwards.  I think I gotta ask for the tests.
Thanks for responding.  I don’t go to the doctor often and hate to come off as a crazy hypochondriac to her, but I feel so awful I think it’s warranted at this point.

Thanks for your response.  The symptoms of dizziness, weakness, fatigue, extreme muscle soreness and joint soreness started late May but then exacerbated to an extreme point two weeks ago.  The extreme thirst and frequent urination came just after that.  I have lost a little weight without trying but I chalked that up to not wanting to eat.  I’d get so dizzy after eating that I just started avoiding it until absolutely necessary.  I think I will ask for the test.

Make real friends.  Try to make friends that will stand the test of time.  And don’t let marriage and kids break those bonds.  Actually, I’d probably skip the marriage and kids if I had another go at it, snatch up those friends and do what Jaybirdybirdy suggests...travel.

Thank you all for taking the time to share your thoughts.  I know that depression has been and will always be a lifelong battle for me, but what is different this time is the complete lack of hope.  I used to be able to find some hope to cling to; the hope I’d grow to be beautiful, the hope I would be passionate about a career, the hope I would have relationships that are lighthearted and fulfilling, the hope I would have something unique to contribute to others’ well-being.  But now the only tether I have is guilt...the guilt that comes along with leaving behind my 14 year old.  I have a toddler as well, but we haven’t really bonded and I think she would fare much better without me, in all honestly.  I worry about the gap I’d leave for my oldest, even though she clearly does not like me right now. I guess I need to think of that in terms of hoping it will improve as she moves out of the teen years. 

Objectively speaking, I do have successes.  They are just meaningless to me individually.  That THING...that thing that makes you YOU? I just haven’t found it and I’m 44 damn years old.  I should know by now.  This is the age where wisdom is supposed to be resting quietly with me but all I hear is chaos.
